latest.title: Local quadratic isoperimetric stability of the truncated octahedron among parallelohedra
latest.abstract: We prove that the Archimedean truncated octahedron is a strict local minimizer of the isoperimetric quotient among all parallelohedra in $\mathbb{R}^3$. After volume normalization and minimization over rotations, the deficit controls the squared Hausdorff distance from the Archimedean cell. This extends the corresponding result from the five-dimensional lattice-Voronoi subclass to the full ten-dimensional local parameter space. A six-zone parametrization and Schur's lemma reduce the Hessian to two positive definite $2\times 2$ matrices.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明阿基米德截角八面体在三维所有平行多面体中是等周商的严格局部极小值，并给出亏损控制旋转优化后 Hausdorff 距离平方的稳定性估计。
latest.breakthrough: 把原先局限于五维 lattice-Voronoi 子类的稳定性扩展到完整十维局部参数空间，并获得定量二次稳定性。
latest.limitations: 结论是局部的且限制在平行多面体类；尚未给出所有空间填充胞体中的全局最优性。
latest.priorityReason: 定量稳定性清晰且技术紧凑，与凸几何和度量稳定性相关，但对象范围较专门。
